results.title: D.I.S.C.O.
results.overview: The operation, which has been carried out in secret by the D.I.S.C.O. intelligence agency for a long time, fails because of Agent Ertan. Ertan, who was suspended from the organization, goes on vacation with his wife Seda. Here, the path crosses with Bandırma Hair Dryer First Zafer and his wife Aynur. Zafer, who learned about Ertan's profession, has only one condition to be silent. To finish Ertan's unfinished operation together. Because the organization that the organization is after is in the same hotel and the fate of the operation is in the hands of Ertan. Ertan, who has never been a field agent in his life, embarks on the operation by having to include Zafer. The unexpected support of Seda and Aynur will change everything.

results.title: Nothing to Lose
results.overview: She gave everything to become a mother, so when her young son falls ill, Jada will stop at  nothing to find a donor and save him — no matter the cost.

results.title: Monay
results.overview: Mona, a desperate woman fighting to save the bakery she shares with her younger sister, Monina. When a wealthy businessman offers financial help in exchange for a risky arrangement, Mona must risk love, family, and herself.

results.title: Sheep in the Box
results.overview: In the near future, architect Otone Komoto is married to Kensuke, who runs a construction company. The married couple decide to welcome a humanoid robot into their home as their son.

results.title: Giant
results.overview: Follows Prince Naseem Hamed from his humble beginnings on the tough working-class streets of Sheffield and his discovery by Ingle, himself a steel industry worker turned boxing trainer. Their unlikely partnership, Naz’s unorthodox style, cocky persona, and sheer dominance in the ring propelled them to the top of boxing’s elite and unprecedented levels of global superstardom, all in the face of the rampant Islamophobia and racism of ’80s and 90’s Britain.

results.title: They Fight
results.overview: Reformed ex-convict Walt Manigan returns home to rebuild his family with the love of his life, Ketta. His path leads him to a boxing gym inside a D.C. youth recreation center about to be closed. There, he works under the wise coach Slim to mentor a group of boys to train for the junior national boxing tournament, all leading to a showdown between best friends Quincey and Peanut as they battle for a spot on the U.S. Junior Olympic Team.

results.title: The Perfect Holiday
results.overview: The group of friends from “Das perfekte Geheimnis” have to ask themselves the question on a chaotic short trip to the south: Is there life after the truth or is their friendship over?

results.title: The Deputy
results.overview: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

results.title: Midwinter Break
results.overview: Longtime retired couple Stella and Gerry realise that their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.

results.title: Love Story
results.overview: One evening, my friend Alyssa confides in me: she has just started a new relationship, but it is already off to a wobbly start! Over the following months, I meet up with her to hear the latest developments. Little by little, her sister and our friends join in, each sharing their takes on the situation.

results.title: How to Lose a Popularity Contest
results.original_title: How to Lose a Popularity Contest
results.overview: A rebellious student and a perfectionist overachiever form an unlikely alliance in their race for student body president, discovering unexpected feelings along the way.

results.title: The Dreadful
results.overview: In medieval England, Anne and her domineering mother-in-law Morwen struggle to survive on the outskirts of society. But when a man from Anne's past returns from war, a curse begins to take shape through a mysterious knight and threatens to destroy them all.

results.title: Volver a los 17
results.overview: Romantic comedy about going back to high school.

results.title: Aasha
results.overview: Follows a stubborn, short-tempered widow named Aasha who gets into a tense altercation with a volatile man named Jeemon following a minor road accident.

results.title: State of Fear
results.overview: As São Paulo erupts in an unprecedented wave of violence, a lawyer with underworld ties must strike a deal with the police to rescue her kidnapped niece.

results.title: Jangan Buang Ibu
results.overview: A single mother struggles to raise her three children while burdened by debt after her husband abandons the family, straining their relationships as her children try to rebuild their bond with her before it is too late.

results.title: Bad Men Must Bleed
results.overview: After a young girl’s family is brutally murdered by ruthless outlaw Harrison Griggs, she forms an unlikely bond with a haunted Civil War veteran turned fugitive known as 'The Butcher'. Together, they must stop Griggs and his gang before he seizes control of the town.

results.title: GJLS: Berapi-Api
results.overview: Three best friends are obsessed with becoming firefighters so they can look heroic by putting out fires. However, after failing during their training with the legendary Algojo Api squad, the three find themselves stuck doing seemingly “trivial” assignments. When they attempt to take a shortcut to join the firefighting team as soon as possible, they instead find themselves caught up in a dangerous mission to rescue children from a criminal syndicate.

results.title: Mouse
results.overview: When her closest friendship is suddenly disrupted the summer before senior year, a teenager struggles to find her footing and develops an unexpected, complicated bond with her best friend’s mother.

results.title: The Hustler
results.overview: Two up-and-coming friends, seeing themselves as the future elite of the new world, oligarchs, they sign up for a major deal, but it turns out that they have been drawn into a massive embezzlement scheme involving billions from the treasury. After his arrest, Andrei ends up in an overcrowded communal cell, a purgatory where he must transform himself into a different person in order to survive and return back to the real world, to his family.
